description: Everything inside a bounding box (min_lat, min_lng, max_lat, max_lng): the true count per type for the whole box plus a capped sample of pins. Agent keys only. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

energy.description: Include energy-fleet infrastructure and projects. Default false.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. Default all four.

fields.description: Only these keys in each row (plus id). Omit for all.

include_country_centroids.description: Also return country-centre placeholder pins (entities known only by country). Default false.

max_lat.description: North edge of the bounding box (latitude).

max_lng.description: East edge of the bounding box (longitude).

min_lat.description: South edge of the bounding box (latitude). Send all four edges together.

min_lng.description: West edge of the bounding box (longitude).

name: map_viewport
